feeds.title: Empress of Dirt
feeds.description: I'm Melissa J. Will a.k.a. the Empress of Dirt (Ontario, Canada). I've got creative and frugal ideas for your home and garden. While many plant care tips are universal, my experience comes from gardening in a cold climate, four-season garden and my tips are mostly suited to US & Canadian zones 4-8. I also share home and garden DIY projects.

feeds.title: Garden Myths
feeds.description: Follow the Garden Myths blog and Learn the truth behind gardening myths and folklore to better understand your garden and plants.

feeds.title: The Garden Girls Blog
feeds.description: Explore our guide to a well-maintained garden, tips for gardening, planting and more! We are a group of ladies who love to garden, pull weeds, trim shrubs, so you can come home and relax in your space!

feeds.title: Hobson's Garden Stories
feeds.description: The Rootbert blog is a personal blog written by Rootbert, a self-proclaimed 'root beer enthusiast.' The blog features articles, recipes, and reviews on all things root beer, from the history of the drink to the best brands to try. If you're looking for information on the history of the drink, recipes for homemade root beer, or reviews of different brands, Rootbert's blog is a great place to start.

feeds.title: Toronto Master Gardeners
feeds.description: Helping Gardeners

feeds.title: Halton Region Master Gardeners
feeds.description: Come Grow with Us

feeds.title: The Peterborough & Area Master Gardeners
feeds.description: We are a group of dedicated gardeners who enjoy volunteering our time and knowledge by providing gardening advice to the public. We meet formally nine times a year on the second Wednesday of the month during which we try to either bring in speakers or go to horticultural establishments for more 'hands on' activities. We exchange ideas, plants, and knowledge within the group and are always keen to keep up with the rapidly changing face of horticulture. Go through our blog to learn more about our work, gardening, horticulture, and more.

feeds.title: Ministry of the Fence
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Crys Stewart. I'm a garden enthusiast, organic horticulture specialist and columnist. But mostly I like to grow stuff, visit other gardens, try to get to know plants and wildlife a little better and then take photos and write about it all. I hope you enjoy these posts and let me know what you think.

feeds.title: Toronto Botanical Garden Blog
feeds.description: Toronto Botanical Garden (TBG) offers an array of themed gardens spanning nearly four acres, designed to educate and inspire adjacent to Wilket Creek, Don Valley Ravine, and Edwards Gardens. We offer a complete range of innovative indoor, outdoor and online learning experiences for all ages and maintain Canada's largest private horticultural library.

feeds.title: Ferns & Feathers Blog
feeds.description: From a single tree on the forest edge to a mature woodland garden with a multi-layered canopy of native plants, ground covers, shrubs, and understory trees that attract birds, bees, butterflies and other pollinators. Woodland gardeners work to create simple low-maintenance landscapes that attract and provide habitat for salamanders, toads, frogs, deer, chipmunks, owls, and backyard birds. Go though our useful blog to know more about gardening, activities, plants, animals, helpful tips, and more.

feeds.title: Royal Botanical Gardens Blog
feeds.description: Royal Botanical Gardens is a National Historic Site of Canada, and features over 2,700 acres of breathtaking gardens and spectacular nature sanctuaries. Follow their blog and Stay informed on all the events, blooms, programs and amazing things that happen at RBG daily.

feeds.title: Northern Wildflowers Blog
feeds.description: Northern Wildflowers is based in Sudbury Ontario and was founded in 2012. It all started as an experiment in growing varieties that could thrive in Northern gardens and provide habitat for pollinators. Our mission is to help our customers create a little slice of a garden paradise. Whether you are looking for seed for your garden, bulk seed for a restoration project, or custom seeds collected for your nursery, we can help. Read our blog to learn more about gardening, types f plans and flowers, useful tips, and more.

feeds.title: The Native Plant Gardener
feeds.description: The Native Plant Gardener blog shares information on the use of native plants in gardening and landscaping. It provides articles, tips, and resources on the subject, including articles on the benefits of native plants, plant profiles, gardening techniques, and the creation of wildlife-friendly habitats.

feeds.title: Georgina Garden Centre Blog
feeds.description: We are a family owned award winning business in Keswick, Ontario that has been serving Georgina and York Region for over 35 years. We specialize in providing an unparalleled selection of garden related products as well as the highest quality of trees, shrubs, perennials, annuals, hanging baskets, houseplants and more.

feeds.title: Stratford Master Gardeners Blog
feeds.description: Stratford and Area Master Gardeners are a group of dedicated gardeners who are passionate about helping home gardeners create sustainable and vibrant gardens. Thorugh our blog, we offer advice, give public presentations and provide education at garden events.

feeds.title: Greenhouse to Garden Blog
feeds.description: The Greenhouse to Garden is a blog maintained by an unknown author, who uses it as a platform to share valuable gardening information and insights. The blog features a diverse range of topics related to gardening, including tips for growing vegetables, flowers, and herbs, landscaping ideas, organic gardening practices, and advice for beginner gardeners.

feeds.title: Terra Greenhouses Blog
feeds.description: Nothing screams Fresh quite like locally grown products. At TERRA we are pleased to bring you the freshest plant material available straight from our own production facilities right in here in Southern Ontario. Read our Terra Greenhouses Blog that shares information on gardening, useful tips, in-depth research of flowers and plants, maintenance ideas, useful gardening guides and more.

feeds.title: My Nordic Garden Blog
feeds.description: Here you can find kitchen gardening tips, garden stories and little anecdotes. Get entertained and informed and set up to more growing success! My Nordic Garden is a consulting company for natural and sustainable kitchen gardens.

feeds.title: Gardening at Last
feeds.description: Gardening at Last is a blog about gardening and is based in Ontario, Canada. It features articles on a variety of gardening topics, including plant selection, soil preparation, watering and fertilizing, pest control, disease prevention, gardening for wildlife, and gardening for sustainability.

feeds.title: The Gardening Me
feeds.description: The Gardening Me is a personal blog that features posts about gardening and farming. The blog's main focus for many years has been on edibles, but it also covers other topics such as ornamental gardening, mindset changes, and personal experiences

feeds.title: The New Perennialist
feeds.description: Tony Spencer is a passionate advocate for naturalistic planting design, and his blog is a valuable resource for anyone interested in learning more about this exciting movement.

feeds.title: OSC Seeds Gardening Blog
feeds.description: Ontario Seed Company has offered over 125 years of growing service and is a proudly Canadian company. At OSC Seeds, our goal is to provide Canadian gardeners with the best quality seed available. Read our blog for expert tips on growing seeds in Canada.

feeds.title: My Backyard Blog
feeds.description: Northern Ontario Living

feeds.title: White Swan Properties
feeds.description: White Swan Properties blog majorly focuses on gardening and ornamental gardens. It provides content, tips, and insights on various aspects of gardening such as plant care, landscaping, and gardening techniques, and features posts about specific plants or gardens.

feeds.title: Grand Erie Master Gardeners Blog
feeds.description: Grand Erie Master Gardeners are experienced gardeners who started as Master Gardeners in Training and had the opportunity to study horticulture through Guelph University courses.

feeds.title: Plantwell Blog
feeds.description: The Plantwell Blog features informative articles and news related to plants and gardening. It provides valuable content on various topics such as plant care, landscaping ideas, indoor gardening tips, and gardening trends. The blog aims to educate and inspire readers, offering insights on plant selection, maintenance, and creating beautiful green spaces.

feeds.title: Garden Jane Blog
feeds.description: The Garden Jane Blog offers permaculture design coaching and education to help people create regenerative community projects, programs and livelihoods.

feeds.title: Durham Master Gardeners
feeds.description: The Durham Master Gardeners (DMG) group was founded in 1987. We are a growing group of members who reside in the Durham Region, Ontario and are, therefore, able to provide gardening advice and information specific to our area. We develop and deliver presentations to local horticultural groups, garden clubs, libraries, local service organizations, and companies, and at gardening events such as the Oshawa Valley Botanical Garden Peony Festival, fairs, home and garden shows, farmers markets, and community garden events.

feeds.title: My Everchanging Garden
feeds.description: Welcome to my garden. I love to garden. I also love to experiment. Throw the two together and you have my everchanging garden. In 2004 we purchased a little over 2 acres in the country in Southern Ontario. My garden has taken many twists and turns since then and I have made many discoveries along the way. My blog is a simple record of how our garden landscape has changed over the years. I also post our family recipes, something I can refer to easily and share among family and friends.

feeds.title: Julia Dimakos Blog
feeds.description: The Gardening Girl blog is managed by Julia Dimakos who enjoys teaching what she has learned in her many years of gardening. Her blog features articles on topics such as vegetable gardening, seed starting, gardening tips, cooking tips, and more.

feeds.title: Crafty Gardener
feeds.description: The Crafty Gardener is a blog dedicated to all things gardening. It offers a wealth of information, tips, and inspiration for both experienced gardeners and beginners. From plant care guides to DIY projects, the blog covers a variety of topics to help readers create and maintain beautiful gardens. The author of the blog Linda has been gardening for the past two decades.

feeds.title: Royal City Nursery Blog
feeds.description: Royal City Nursery has grown quite a bit since its humble beginnings but we have never lost sight of the vision behind our company sharing the love of growing and cultivating and helping our customers experience the joy that comes from creating unique living spaces. Follow our blog and learn more about our nursery, our plants, activities, useful gardening tips, and more.
